# Preview: Angers vs Lorient - prediction, team news, lineups

By   Freddie Cotton   |

Angers vs Lorient - prediction, team news, lineups/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F09%2Fstephane-gilli-6a9ac4565459c954964346.jpg)

© Iconsport / Christophe Saidi

Angers welcome Lorient to the Stade Raymond-Kopa on Sunday afternoon for round eight of the 2026-27 Ligue 1 campaign. [...] Following a promising return to the French top flight last season, finishing 10th and an impressive 21 points clear of the automatic relegation places, Lorient will be delighted having made a great start to the 2026-27 Ligue 1 campaign. [...] In their previous league outing, Les Scoistes suffered a damning 5-2 home defeat to a resurgent Marseille side, while Les Merlus posted a 1-0 win over AS Monaco at the Stade du Moustoir.

## Match preview

Having narrowly avoided the drop in each of the previous two years, finishing four points above the relegation playoff position in the 2025-26 campaign, Angers look as though they could be fighting towards the foot of the Ligue 1 table again this season after a mixed start.
